snippet.title: Max Payne Mods - Part 04: Max Payne @ University
snippet.description:
Max Payne @ University is a Total Conversion for the first Max Payne game. The main setting is the real-life premises and surrounding areas of the Computer Engineering and Informatics Department, a.k.a CEID in Patras, Greece.

This modification integrates the Kung Fu 3 Deluxe Engine (by Kenneth Yeung, MrUniq) and the Enemy Kung Fu (by Ghasp) engine. It also features 5 level maps, some new weapons, and a new standalone story for Max.

The story unfolds through cutscenes, graphic novels, and the in-game actions of the player.
Moreover, at one point, the game will allow you to make a choice that will affect the final outcome of the story.

🎮 Featured Title: Max Payne @ University 
🏢 Developer: stroggoff
📅 Release Date: 2006
🏷️ Genre: Action, Third-Person Shooter, Total Conversion Mod
